test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'option 2'** i.e.** "named".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In this context,** the crater has been given a specific name, "Nadir," after the nearby volcano, Nadir Seamount.
 
• Thus**, "named" **is the most suitable word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *The ocean floor is famously less explored than the surface of Mars. And when our team of scientists recently mapped the seabed, and ancient sediments beneath, we discovered what looks like an asteroid impact crater. Intriguingly, the crater, **named** “Nadir” after the nearby volcano Nadir Seamount, is of the same age as the Chicxulub impact caused by a huge asteroid at the end of the Cretaceous (4)______, around 66 million years ago, which (5)______ the dinosaurs and many other species.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"Dropped"** generally means to let or make (something) fall vertically. It does not fit here because the sentence is about giving a name to the crater, not about dropping something.
 
• **"Murmured"** usually refers to a soft, low, or indistinct sound made by a person or group of people speaking quietly or at a distance. It does not fit in the given context.
 
• **"Squeaked"** means to make a short, high-pitched sound or cry. This also doesn't make sense in this context.
